title.narrative: BPRP funded support for capacity building at the DRC PRSP unit

description.narrative: " The main project development objective (PDO) is to build institutional capacity at the PRSP unit to allow it fulfil its assigned tasks. As noted above the PRSP unit is an inter-ministerial unit that coordinates the drafting of the PRSP, consults with stakeholders at the national and provincial levels, analyzes the relevant data, keeps records of relevant documents, and monitors the PRSP implementation. This project envisages to strengthen the institutional capacity of the PRSP unit to deliver the above-listed functions: "" Consultation with authorities and civil society in the DRC provinces to ensure that the national PRSP objectives are well understood and supported at the level of the provinces. "" Capacity to identify monitoring and evaluation indicators and assess their evaluation over time. "" Analysis of the household survey data that are being collected by the National Institute for Statistics. "" Archiving of documents in a systematic way, while using the existing capacity at the INS to archive data. "" Support the updating of macroeconomic developments in the DRC provinces during a single year during which the INS is not yet in a position to update these developments independently as would have been the INS' natural role."
